description: This source file defines the utility class SecurityUtil, which provides methods for assessing user permissions, generating and validating JWT tokens, and other security-related functionalities within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: SecurityUtil
classes.description: A final utility class offering security-related static methods for permission checks, JWT token generation/validation, and permission comparison logic within the Ofbiz security framework.

methods.name: hasUserLoginAdminPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user login has at least one admin permission from a predefined set, based on user login ID and delegator.

methods.name: hasUserLoginMorePermissionThan
methods.description: Determines permissions that a user login has more of compared to another user login, returning missing permissions if any.

methods.name: checkMultiLevelAdminPermissionValidity
methods.description: A helper method to check if a permission has valid multi-level admin permission prefixes.

methods.name: generateJwtToAuthenticateUserLogin
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a user login, incorporating the user login ID and current password as a salt.

methods.name: authenticateUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Validates a JWT token to verify it matches the user login ID and the current password.
